lara.marketing: Tiny follow-up: can runtime run a reproducibility slice for the webinar demo (N=20 pairs) to confirm p95 stability across two consecutive runs? We want to show "deterministic-ish" behavior in the demo notes. cc @sam.runtime

sam.runtime: Sure. We'll run two back-to-back runs with the same seed and config and compute per-sample delta. Which model/variant?

lara.marketing: redwood-alpha-8k q4_2-v2, tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v3, context 8k, seed=999. Keep cache=on. Deliver per-sample delta CSV and a short note if any outliers > 2x p95 delta.

mike.eng: Also include run-level hashes and config file so marketing can reproduce. We'll scrub any infra-specific hostnames.

opsbot: Job queued: #3501 (link https://rundashboard/jobs/3501)

sam.runtime: ETA 04:00 UTC tomorrow, expected wall time 40m. We'll attach artifacts to /share/marketing/webinar-repro/1722003333/ and ping when ready.

lara.marketing: Thanks! Appreciate it.
